newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices eased late Wednesday, tracking plunging futures prices, traders said.

Traders said BP returned an idled unit at its 155,000 barrel per day Toledo, Ohio refinery to service and the outage was no longer a factor in the market after firming Chicago basis earlier in the week.
"BP Toledo appears to be back up," one trader said. BP has declined comment on the outage.
High sulphur diesel remained 5.75 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and 1.25/0.75 cents under in Group Three on flagging agricultural demand, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel for prompt October deliveries was talked 3.25/3.0 cents under the print in Chicago and 0.75/1.0 cent over the print in Group Three, where later deliveries were 0.50 cent weaker.
Unleaded was bid 1.25 cents under the print in both markets for prompt deliveries and 1.50 cents under for later deliveries, traders said.
Jet/kero was steady at 1.25/1.50 cent over the print in Chicago and 1.75/2.0 cents over in Group Three for all October timings.
